title: Derrick Boddie — 'A verified human generated product is gonna be like a super premium item.'
summary: Boddie is a brand and digital strategist. He builds a post around a line Eric delivered on Greg Nelson's Digital Disruption podcast, and extends it into an argument that human-made is becoming a luxury label now that AI authorship is the default assumption about any piece of work.
blockquote: Eric Ries said something on Digital Disruption with Greg Nelson that stuck with me: "A verified human generated product is gonna be like a super premium item." Think about that for a second. We're entering a world where the default assumption is that AI made it. And the brands that can prove a human was behind the work? They'll charge more for it.
